##### Project general facts

Fay Gardens is a prestigious sustainable villa community developed through a landmark collaboration between Taraf and Masdar City, two of Abu Dhabi's most respected and forward-thinking development entities united by a shared vision of creating a city in perfect balance with nature, designed for a relaxed and mindful lifestyle, comprising 130 villas with four, five, and six bedrooms. It is a development that positions itself boldly as Abu Dhabi's new green heart, where every planning decision — from shaded walking trails and landscaped plazas to generous gathering spaces — is made in service of a richer, more connected way of living.

Fay Gardens delivers a compelling and holistic lifestyle infrastructure centred on wellness, community, and the seamless blending of indoor and outdoor life. A dedicated Community Clubhouse serves as the social and recreational anchor of the development, while the three thematic park environments — grounded Terra Park, rejuvenating Aria Park, and serene Azura Park — create a layered landscape of wellness experiences that surround residents at every turn. Shaded walking trails, community plazas, and thoughtfully designed gathering spaces complete an amenity offering that prioritises genuine quality of life above all else.

The interiors of Fay Gardens villas are crafted for stillness, guided by a design language of soft colours, warm textures, and honest natural materials that invite comfort and calm from the moment of arrival. Wood and natural finishes define the character of every room, while floor-to-ceiling openings dissolve the boundary between interior and exterior, drawing in light, air, and the beauty of the surrounding gardens. Kitchens and master bathrooms are executed to a high standard of quality, with smart family-friendly spatial planning ensuring that every part of the home functions as beautifully as it looks.

##### Location description and benefits

Masdar City occupies a uniquely visionary position within the Abu Dhabi metropolitan area — a purpose-built, sustainability-focused urban community that represents one of the most ambitious and celebrated green development projects anywhere in the world. The setting is defined by a sense of considered calm and environmental intention, with clean air, lush landscaping, and a pedestrian-friendly environment creating a living experience that feels distinctly different from conventional urban neighbourhoods. It is a location where the built environment and the natural world exist in genuine, designed harmony, bathed in the warm open skies and sunlight that characterise Abu Dhabi's most desirable residential addresses.

The community's connectivity is exceptional, placing residents within comfortable reach of Abu Dhabi's most important destinations without sacrificing the sense of retreat that makes the address so special. Abu Dhabi International Airport is reachable in very little time — ideal for internationally mobile residents and investors — while Khalifa City, Yas Island, and Zayed University all sit comfortably close for everyday convenience, entertainment, and education. The direct road connections ensure that the very best of Abu Dhabi is always within effortless reach.

Fay Gardens presents a genuinely rare opportunity to own a sustainable villa within one of Abu Dhabi's most forward-thinking addresses, at a moment when green living has moved from aspiration to expectation among the world's most discerning buyers. The Taraf and Masdar City partnership brings together development credibility, sustainability expertise, and a long-term vision that underpins both lifestyle quality and investment confidence in equal measure. For those seeking a villa that offers beauty, purpose, and lasting value in one of the Gulf's most exciting cities, this is an address of exceptional and enduring appeal.
